title: Public Medical-Aesthetics Universe — Book-of-Watches (BREADTH pass)
analyst_note: BREADTH map of the public aesthetics universe. Deep-diligenced names (EOLS BUY-small/spec, LFMD WATCH) and screened-out names (HIMS, ABBV) carried from prior medspa run; Galderma/InMode/Establishment Labs flagged deep-dive-in-flight (NOT re-done here). Every NEW name gated through discovery_state(). discovery_state run logged to outputs/latency_log.jsonl (source_connector=aesthetics_breadth_screen). HARD GUARD (GXI lesson): foreign-primary listings (KR/HK/CH) have NO US FTD/FINRA-SI/StockTwits feed -> positioning_score=0.0 is a MISSING-DATA ARTIFACT, not low crowding. Wikipedia is the only live attention channel for them. These are tagged UNDISCOVERED_POSITIONING_UNVERIFIABLE and CANNOT be called cleanly under-discovered. This is the dominant structural finding of the breadth pass: the genuinely interesting new aesthetics names are foreign-listed, exactly where the conditioning layer is blind.

conditioning_layer_caveats.foreign_positioning_blind_spot: KR (KOSDAQ) and HK names: no SEC FTD, no FINRA short interest, no US StockTwits. positioning_score forced to 0.0 = artifact. google_trends + gdelt also UNAVAILABLE on this cloud IP. Only Wikipedia pageviews survive as a live attention read -> confidence=LOW on every foreign name.
conditioning_layer_caveats.implication: Cannot distinguish 'genuinely undiscovered' from 'discovered-by-foreign-institutions-we-cannot-see' for Hugel/Medytox/Sisram. Treat their UNDISCOVERED tag as UNRELIABLE. A US ADR or a US-feed positioning proxy would be needed to condition them.

ranking_logic: Ordered by (real+durable exposure x under-discovered x asymmetry). EOLS #1: only name clean on ALL THREE gates (real / compounding-durable / genuinely UNDISCOVERED on a LIVE US feed). Hugel #2: highest real+durable exposure + best NEW catalyst (US Letybo ramp +105% Americas) but conditioning-BLIND (foreign positioning UNVERIFIABLE) so cannot confirm under-discovery. Sisram #3 / Medytox #4: real but either wrong-side-of-thesis-cyclical+China-controlled (Sisram) or US-catalyst-unrealized+already-de-rated (Medytox), both conditioning-blind.

follow_on_deep_dive_flags.why: Best NEW real+durable+catalyzed name (US Letybo launch ramping); blocked only by the foreign-positioning blind spot. Worth a deep-dive WITH a foreign-crowding workaround (Korean institutional ownership, KOSDAQ short-balance, BENEV US sell-through) to de-blind the conditioning read.

Already BUY-small but the undiscovered-AND-cheap-for-reasons caveat (unprofitable/levered/guide-cut into soft toxin tape) needs the quant quality/balance-sheet + toxin-cyclicality verdict before sizing up. Hand the decisive UNDISCOVERED divergence to signalos-quant-analyst.

Only if a deeper look wants the cheapest EBD optionality — but lead with the value-trap risks (71% Fosun control, China overhang, capex cyclicality, float liquidity). Lower priority than the two above.

actionable_summary: Per the conditioning gate, the ONLY name surfaced as cleanly ACTIONABLE (regime=UNDISCOVERED on a LIVE feed) is EOLS (already in watch as BUY-small/spec). Every genuinely interesting NEW aesthetics name (Hugel, Medytox, Sisram) is foreign-primary and therefore UNDISCOVERED_POSITIONING_UNVERIFIABLE — surfaced as WATCH / follow-on-deep-dive, NOT as a clean buy, because the layer cannot rule out foreign-institutional crowding. The breadth pass's main finding: the public US aesthetics universe is largely PICKED-OVER or PRIVATIZED (Revance/Cutera/Venus/Sientra/EWCZ all gone-private 2024-2026), and the remaining edge sits in foreign listings precisely where our conditioning layer is blind.
